origin.description: Create a tabular representation of the response in a balanced groupedData object.
origin.details: A balanced groupedData object can be represented as a matrix or table of response values corresponding to the values of a primary covariate for each level of a grouping factor. This function creates such a matrix representation of the data in object.
origin.value: A matrix. The data in the matrix are the values of the response. The columns correspond to the distinct values of the primary covariate and are labelled as such. The rows correspond to the distinct levels of the grouping factor and are labelled as such.

translation.description: Build a labeled matrix of response values for each grouping level and primary covariate level in balanced grouped data.

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: A GroupedData object (or compatible object with response, covariate, groups, and group_levels) that is balanced and single-level.

translation.details: Counts are taken like R's table(getGroups, getCovariate); every cell must have the same count. Values are filled in covariate-then-group order, column-major like R's matrix assignment.
translation.value: A Table with values, row_names (group levels), and col_names (covariate levels). str() prints like the R matrix.
